opening.text: I'm here because I've been having a rough time since I got back. Years ago I was deployed to East Africa, and four months in, I came under enemy gunfire. I was taking mefloquine 250 mg once a week for malaria prevention, and I kept it up for six months. About two weeks after I started that medication, I began having anxiety and vivid dreams. Since then, I've had mood swings, getting angry and irritable, and I have real trouble concentrating. Physically, I have persistent 'sea legs,' like I'm on a boat, plus a constant spinning dizziness. I also get distinct attacks of vertigo that last 20 to 30 minutes, and I've actually been falling.
